description:
The Ministry of Health has launched a new 'Hospital Waste Management' initiative. As the DHIS2 Administrator, you need to configure the system to collect monthly data. 

1. Log in to DHIS2 (admin / district).
2. In the Maintenance app, create two new Data Elements:
   - Name: 'Waste Generated (kg)', Short name: 'Waste Gen', Value Type: Number, Aggregation: Sum, Domain: Aggregate.
   - Name: 'Waste Incinerated (kg)', Short name: 'Waste Incin', Value Type: Number, Aggregation: Sum, Domain: Aggregate.
   - Use the 'default' Category Combination for both.
3. Create a new Dataset named 'Hospital Waste Management':
   - Period Type: Monthly
   - Add the two new data elements to this dataset.
   - Assign the dataset to 'Bo District' and all its sub-units (including facilities).
4. In the Data Entry app, enter the following data for 'Bo Government Hospital' for January 2024:
   - Waste Generated: 150
   - Waste Incinerated: 120
   - Mark the dataset as Complete.
